ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the above food web diagram, what does rotifer represent?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food web. On the left, the node labeled “Algae” has an arrow pointing to “Rotifer”. From “Rotifer” there are also arrows pointing respectively to “Artemia” and “Mysid”, and the food web continues to connect to organisms such as seahorses. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows indicate that food or energy flows from the organism being eaten to the eater. Rotifer receives food/energy from Algae, indicating that it eats algae rather than making its own food. Therefore Rotifer represents a consumer.
